prose.subject: Quick Reminder: Invoice INV-86799 for Greywater Robotics
prose.body:
Hi Greywater Robotics team,

Hope you're having a great week! Just wanted to send a friendly nudge regarding invoice INV-86799, which is currently outstanding.

The amount due is 2081.73 USDC. To keep things moving smoothly, please remit payment to our standard vendor wallet at 0xedb38ee7c9e7ae69483f75d830b9fc4f0e162d90. As always, we appreciate your prompt attention to this matter.

If you’ve already sent the payment, please ignore this email. If you have any questions about the invoice details or need a copy of the statement, just let us know. We’re here to help!

Thanks so much for your partnership.

Best regards,

The Larchmont Cloud Billing Team
